_comment: An INPUT SKOS concept scheme layered over CCO. This is the shape a user supplies: concepts with a prefLabel, altLabels (the lexical surface CCO lacks), a broader link into CCO's hierarchy, and domain/range in CCO's own class vocabulary. Nothing here is a hardcoded predicate in the code — it is data, and swapping this file swaps the vocabulary. CCO supplies the upper structure and the entity classes; this supplies the everyday relations a conversation actually asserts, which CCO does not model as binary predicates because BFO treats them as processes.

classes.label: Dance Studio
classes.definition: A facility where dance is taught, rehearsed or performed.

classes.label: Store
classes.definition: A facility where goods are sold to the public.

classes.label: Hobby
classes.definition: An activity pursued regularly for pleasure rather than payment.

classes.label: Illness
classes.definition: A condition of poor health affecting a person.

classes.label: Trip
classes.definition: A journey to a place and back.

properties.label: works for
properties.definition: The person is employed by the organization.

properties.label: formerly worked for
properties.definition: The person was employed by the organization in the past and no longer is.

properties.label: works at
properties.definition: The person is employed at the facility.

properties.label: has occupation
properties.definition: The role the person is employed in.

properties.label: likes
properties.definition: The person enjoys or is enthusiastic about the thing.

properties.label: plans to
properties.definition: The person intends to bring the act about.

properties.label: lives in
properties.definition: The person resides in the place.

properties.label: attended
properties.definition: The person took part in the event.

properties.label: friend of
properties.definition: A mutual social relationship, not family and not work.

properties.label: cares for
properties.definition: The person looks after the animal or person.

properties.label: studied at
properties.definition: The person was educated at the organization.

properties.label: teaches
properties.definition: The person instructs others in the subject or act.

coarseAliases._comment: The extractor's generic labels, mapped to the CCO class each one MEANS. Without this the graph carries 'person' as a bare string while properties declare domain 'Person', so every assertion reads as a type violation and no inference fires. Data, not code.
